for i, row in enumerate(test_grid):
    if len(set(row)) == 1:
        # Uniform row - unchanged
        output_grid.append(row)
        continue
    
    # Count frequencies
    vals = Counter(row)
    first_value = row[0]
    
    # Find HIGH_COUNT value (the value with highest frequency among non-first values)
    non_first_counts = {k: v for k, v in vals.items() if k != first_value}
    
    if non_first_counts:
        high_count_value = max(non_first_counts, key=non_first_counts.get)
        high_count = non_first_counts[high_count_value]
    else:

        high_count = 0

    else:

        result = [1 if x == high_count_value else first_value for x in row]
    
    output_grid.append(result)
